purpose_text.para: Reads of CNTPCT_EL0 return the 64-bit physical count value minus a physical offset.

configuration_text.para: All reads to the CNTPCT_EL0 occur in program order relative to reads to CNTPCTSS_EL0 or CNTPCT_EL0.

field_description.para: If the access is not trapped and all of the following are true, then reads of CNTPCT_EL0 from EL0 or EL1 return (PhysicalCountInt<63:0> - CNTPOFF_EL2<63:0>):

listitem.content: EL2 is implemented and enabled in the current Security state.
The Effective value of HCR_EL2.{E2H, TGE} is not {1, 1}.

field_description.para: Otherwise, reads of CNTPCT_EL0 return PhysicalCountInt<63:0>.
PhysicalCountInt is defined by 'The Physical Counter'.

ps.name: MRS
